scope: Representative output coverage of eight source-indexed artist portfolios, not catalogue-raisonne or lifetime completeness. Inigo Quilez is handled independently by root.

artists.denominator_note: 74 named top-level entries plus four named Interval children. Interval parent expanded rather than counted as a separate artwork; nine curatorial/non-output entries excluded.
51 distinct named projects in accessible primary index; fourteen legacy applet/canvas entries have only unusably small public thumbnail images in this pass.
47 creator-owned project cards. Dedicated generators plus one procedural dungeon-game example retained; thirteen other games/textual simulations explicitly excluded.
All 98 work tiles, including named film works nested in series; nine series navigation labels group these works and are not additional works.
Full Works archive paginated to final page9: eight pages of ten and one page of nine. Includes installations, physical realizations, animation and collaborative projects.

18+11 public project cards. Page2 HTML title says of6, but linked pagination ends at2 and directly checked pages3–6 contain zero cards. Ten articles/tool covers/community sites excluded after visual review.
All seventeen linked named series/period groups from DAM artist presentation, each with its detail gallery. Not a census of all museum holdings or her entire lifetime oeuvre.

Current portfolio has twelve slots: eight visual collections and four resource/documentation/product exclusions. Historical index adds two named Dub works and five non-output/compilation exclusions after deduplicating shared collections.
artists.collection_unit: named collection or historical output group
